Deltana SS45BU32  4-1/2 x 4-1/2 x Square Corners Stainless Steel Hinge with 4 Ball Bearings

text.description_html:
Deltana SS45BU32, 4-1/2" x 4-1/2" Heavy Duty Polished Stainless Steel Hinge with 4 Ball Bearings

Package includes a pair of hinges (2), matching Stainless Steel flathead, Phillips Drive #12 x 1-1/4" wood screws and #12-24 x 1/2" machine screws. Shiny Polished Stainless Steel finish.

Fitted with a high grade, removable, rust resistant, stainless steel pin. Utilizes template screw hole pattern for use with wood or metal doors.

Specifications: for Deltana SS45BU32 4.5 Polished Stainless Hinges

  • Hinge Material: 304 Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Polished Stainless Steel
  • Height: 4-1/2"
  • Width: 4-1/2"
  • Corners: Square
  • Thickness: 0.129" (Heavy Duty)
  • Ball Bearings: 4BB
  • Standard Template Hole Pattern
  • Hinge Pin: Stainless Steel
  • Wood Screws: #12 x 1-1/4"
  • Machine Screws: #12-24 x 1/2"
  • Deltana SS45BU32 Hinge Specifications (PDF)

Sold in Pairs (2 Hinges)
